spec_notes: Package @aphanarc_lab/hermes-webui is a CLI launcher for Hermes WebUI dashboard. It manages a Python-based web server. The 'doctor' command runs health checks and outputs diagnostics. This capability wraps 'doctor' as a tool that accepts optional config via input_path (e.g. {"hermesHome": "/custom/path"}) and writes structured JSON results to output_path. First run installs Python deps (~5MB) into a venv under HERMES_HOME; subsequent runs are fast. Exit code 1 is expected when Hermes Agent is not installed (common in test envs). The CLI is ESM-only (bin/hermes-webui.mjs), so we spawn it via node. Set HERMES_WEBUI_CLI_PATH env var if the package is installed elsewhere.
